project: Super Mario All-Stars (25th Anniversary Edition) native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays Super Mario Bros. 1-1. Known problem: the game switches the video to PAL 50 Hz, so it runs at 50 fps and judders a little on a 60 Hz display. Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the menus. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
